articles.title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
articles.abstract: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.

articles.titleCn: 甲虫：一种双语模型套件，用于模拟第二语言处理
articles.abstractCn: 双语语言模型（LMs）为研究训练条件如何塑造第二语言（L2）行为提供了可控环境，但以往研究通常同时改变暴露结构、规模和架构，难以将效果归因于单一因素。我们介绍了Beetle，一个可控的语言模型预训练框架，其中分词器、目标语言、训练预算和暴露结构均可独立操控，从而实现训练条件的系统化和可比性实验。利用Beetle，我们训练并发布了285个双语和45个单语开源LM，涵盖多种暴露时间表、数据规模和第一语言（L1），以研究多语言预训练和双语及第二语言学习的计算建模。在人类双语者和第二语言阅读时间预测及语法判断任务上评估模型，我们发现分阶段和时序结构的课程体系与平衡双语训练相比，始终能更好地与语言学习者阅读时间对齐，在数据规模较小和语言类型学距离较近的语言对中效果最为显著。Beetle模型是推动计算心理语言学超越其普遍的单语、英语中心焦点，转向人类双语处理模型，研究跨语言学习动态的有力工具，同时支持基于社区的可控模型家族开发。

articles.title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
articles.abstract: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

articles.titleCn: 预训练人格混合模型和串联模型用于人类模拟
articles.abstractCn: 我们在此主张，当前大型语言模型（LLM）人类模拟的主流做法——通过指令微调的助手语言模型进行角色扮演——是不准确的，并且会产生刻板印象的预测（缺乏自然多样性）。此前已有研究表明，LLM可以通过自然文本对话来绑定角色，从而避免刻板印象。在此，我们展示可以通过特定人群的简短对话样本来实现绑定。通过简单地查询模型，可以在后期添加人口统计信息而不产生负面影响。我们使用“角色混合模型（PMMs）”这一术语来指代经过良好校准的人类模型，目前以预训练基础模型的形式实现。我们证明，PMMs比指令微调模型产生更准确的预测，并保留了人类对话中更多的词汇、语义和语用多样性。我们通过跨开放域文本、人机聊天和人类说话者之间任务导向对话的多样化语料库，测量了LLM模拟人类对话者的真实性和多样性。然而，基础预训练模型可能会产生域外对话，并在长上下文中丢失部分人类内部状态。我们提出并探索了结合预训练模型和指令微调监督者的串联模型。串联模型在我们的实验中实现了最佳的整体准确性和多样性。

articles.title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
articles.abstract: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

articles.titleCn: 保留重要内容：摘要评估中超越饱和状态的语义框架
articles.abstractCn: 摘要评估在无数生产系统中得到应用，使得模型选择成为一项依赖于衡量摘要质量的常规决策。现有指标难以支持这一需求：ROUGE仅捕捉表面重叠，而将大型语言模型作为评判者时，评分会饱和至近乎相同的值，无法有效对模型进行排序。我们在三个公共数据集、两个专有数据集以及多语言环境下观察到这种现象。为此，我们引入了语义骨架（Semantic Scaffold）这一评估框架，该框架从源文本中提取事实、问题和实体属性的金字塔式表示，将其标记为主要观点或支撑细节，并将此结构作为固定的参考标准用于评分摘要。基于此表示，我们推导出三种诊断指标：事实保留分数（FPS）、问题保留分数（QPS）和实体保留分数（EPS），旨在奖励关键信息的保留，同时惩罚细节过载，并将它们定位为可解释的诊断工具，在整体评估维度失效时仍能提供有效信息。最后，我们分析了ROUGE和LLM作为评判者评分的四种常见失效模式，证明基于骨架的评估在传统指标失效时仍能提供有价值的信息。

articles.title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.
articles.titleCn: 学生LLM是否会继承OOD鲁棒性？不变权重蒸馏以实现可靠知识迁移
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏（KD）旨在将高性能的教师大型语言模型压缩成轻量级的学生模型。然而，蒸馏后的学生模型在分布外（OOD）场景中往往表现出显著的性能退化，这是一个尚未得到充分探索的关键问题。我们识别出导致分布外性能退化的两个复合机制：（1）数据虚假性：学生模型可能在蒸馏数据集中学习到虚假相关性，而非真实的因果关系；（2）教师能力：标准KD对所有样本一视同仁，忽略了教师是否被因果特征引导或被样本上的虚假捷径误导。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了不变权蒸馏（IWD），这是一个具有理论基础的框架，通过在多个合成环境中基于预测不变性估计教师对因果关系的依赖，动态地重新加权训练样本。IWD扰动虚假线索的同时保留核心语义，对那些教师预测保持不变（表明更依赖因果关系而非虚假特征）的样本分配更高的蒸馏权重。我们理论上证明，与标准均匀加权KD相比，IWD降低了学生模型的虚假对因果（S2C）梯度比率，推动学生模型朝向更不变的表达形式。在四个NLP基准（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003命名实体识别和SST-2）上的实验（跨越DeBERTa-v3和Qwen-2.5两个模型家族）表明，IWD在分布外评估中始终优于强大的KD基线，同时保持有竞争力的分布内（ID）性能。具体而言，IWD在16个分布外基准中的15个中实现了最高准确率，并在NLI和QA上将标准KD的平均分布外性能提升了4.34和14.94个百分点。

articles.title: ufakzeka-1: Building and Evaluating a 151M-Parameter Turkish Language Model from Scratch
articles.abstract: We describe ufakzeka-1, a 151M-parameter (182M with embeddings) decoder-only Turkish language model pretrained from scratch on 13.5B tokens of openly licensed text and instruction-tuned for chat, at a total cost of about \$286 in cloud GPU, API and notebook time. The contribution is not the model's capability, which is what a model this size can be expected to have, but the record of building and measuring it: a Turkish byte-level tokenizer at 1.77 tokens per word, a three-stage pretraining schedule, a post-training mixture of openly licensed and generated data, and an evaluation battery of release gates, a rule-checked sweep of 5,508 conversations, judged conversations and hand tests, all with prompts held out from the training data, enforced by decontamination inside the data build and by a checked-in invariant script we run before each build. We report three findings that we believe transfer to other small-model efforts: a safety gate that had been "fixed" with training data written from its own questions read 64/64 while the honest figure was 34/64; training-seed variance was as large as the spread across every recipe we tried, so single-seed comparisons at this scale are uninformative; and data rounds repaired only what was absent from the data, while identity tracking over long context and multi-turn arithmetic did not move across any data change we tried, which we read as limits of the model size rather than gaps in the data, a reading the next, larger model will test. Weights, the data recipe, the evaluation code and the spend ledger are released under Apache-2.0.
articles.comment: 8 pages. Model, code, evaluation results and demo: https://ufakzeka.com, https://huggingface.co/ufakai, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka
articles.titleCn: ufakzeka-1：从零开始构建和评估一个1.51亿参数的土耳其语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们描述了ufakzeka-1，一个拥有1.51亿参数（包含嵌入时为1.82亿）的纯解码器式土耳其语言模型。该模型从头开始在13.50亿个开放许可文本上进行预训练，并针对聊天进行了指令微调，总成本约为286美元的云GPU、API和笔记本时间。这项贡献并非模型的性能，即这种规模的模型所应具备的能力，而是其构建和测量的记录：一个每词1.77个token的土耳其字节级分词器、一个三阶段预训练计划、一个包含开放许可和生成数据的后训练混合数据集，以及一系列评估方法，包括发布门禁、对5,508次对话的规则检查扫描、评判对话和人工测试，所有测试均使用未在训练数据中出现的提示，通过在数据构建过程中的净化措施以及每次构建前运行的经过检查的不变性脚本强制执行。我们报告了三个我们认为可推广到其他小型模型工作的发现：一个安全门，其训练数据是由模型自己的问题生成的，其中64/64的问题被“修复”，而真实情况是34/64；训练种子方差与我们所尝试的每个配方之间的差异一样大，因此在此规模上的单种子比较是无信息的；数据轮次仅修复了数据中缺失的内容，而跨长上下文和多轮算术的身份跟踪在任何我们尝试的数据变化中都没有改变，我们将其解读为模型规模的限制，而非数据缺陷，这一点将在下一个更大规模的模型中得到验证。权重、数据配方、评估代码和支出记录已根据Apache-2.0协议发布。

articles.title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
articles.abstract: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available
articles.titleCn: 精准诊断，优化反馈：用于逻辑证明中忠实LLM辅导反馈的符号验证器
articles.abstractCn: 有效的LLM辅导依赖于在生成反馈之前准确识别学生推理中的具体错误。我们在命题逻辑证明辅导中研究这一问题，其中学生行为可以与形式推理规则进行核对。我们引入了一种基于验证器的架构，将诊断与语言生成分离。使用600个平衡的学生行为，我们比较了一个零样本LLM检测器、一个微调检测器和一个符号验证器。每个诊断都由共享的推理和反馈代理处理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。零样本检测器实现了0.191的宏观F1值；微调将这一数值提高到0.709，但仍然保留了结构相关类别之间的系统性错误。推理通常保留了它们所接收的诊断，表明一个错误的诊断可以通过管道被忠实地传播。反馈也可以在处理错误时保持对推理的忠实、不泄露信息且具有教育意义。基于验证器的反馈实现了最高的诊断正确性，而专家评分与自动反馈评估结果差异较大。这些发现表明，明显的反馈质量可能掩盖上游的诊断错误，而忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。我们的代码是公开可用的。

articles.title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI
articles.abstract: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

articles.titleCn: 使用留一方言交叉验证和可解释人工智能进行孟加拉方言的跨方言命名实体识别
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语是世界上第七大使用最广泛的语言，表现出显著的区域方言多样性，如巴里萨尔、吉大港、锡尔赫特、诺阿卡利和迈门辛等方言在词汇、形态和句法特征上存在差异。这些差异给命名实体识别（NER）带来了巨大挑战，限制了在标准孟加拉语或单一区域方言上训练的模型的泛化能力。本文提出了一种跨方言孟加拉语NER框架，使用了公开可用的ANCHOLIK-NER数据集，该数据集包含17,405个标注句子和101,817个标记，涵盖了孟加拉语五个主要区域方言。采用留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV）策略，在四个方言上训练模型，并在剩余未见的方言上进行评估。在相同的实验设置下评估了八种预训练的基于transformer的模型，包括BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa和Multilingual-E5。Multilingual-E5 Large在每一折中都取得了最高的F1分数，在迈门辛方言上达到97.26%的最高点，在最具挑战性的目标方言吉大港上达到82.38%的最低点。为了提高可解释性，对词级预测应用了局部可解释模型无关解释（LIME），揭示模型的决策主要受目标实体词本身的表层形式驱动，而非周围句子上下文。这些研究结果为跨方言孟加拉语NER建立了基准，展示了基于transformer的迁移学习对低资源区域方言的有效性，同时强调了当前模型对表层形式的依赖性，为未来的工作指明了方向。

articles.title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
articles.abstract: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.
articles.titleCn: 当余弦相似度无法反映对话模型中的线性可访问结构时
articles.abstractCn: 余弦相似度被广泛应用于分析Transformer表示，其隐含假设是相似度反映了与任务相关的结构。我们研究了在对话条件的大型语言模型中，这一假设何时失效。在三个7-8B的聊天微调模型中，环境余弦相似度在相同的隐藏状态上显著低估了线性可解码的角色结构；数值上，线性探针AUC在0.73-0.97范围内，而余弦kNN在0.56-0.77范围内，在一个30类任务上。一个低维监督子空间能解释大部分这种差距，而一个匹配秩的PCA子空间则不能，并且在某些情况下会降低性能。这种不匹配与模式相关：在单句情感分类（SST-5）中不存在这种不匹配，并且一个匹配基数控制排除了属性基数作为混杂因素。差距不会随着对话轮次的增加而系统性地增加，并且任务对齐的子空间随时间保持稳定。然而，三个模型中的两个违反了预先注册的子空间内可分离性不变性标准（|Δ AUC | <= 0.03），并且一个模型违反了预先注册的轮次不变性标准（|Δ L | <= 0.05）。这些结果表明，即使在结构线性可访问的情况下，余弦相似度也可能无法反映对话表示中的任务对齐结构。

articles.title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
articles.abstract: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

articles.titleCn: CultureMINE：提升NLP系统文化能力的数据集与方法
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，文化自然语言处理（Cultural NLP）领域引起了广泛关注，人们致力于构建全球包容性的自然语言处理系统。该领域文献的快速增长使得追踪方法和数据资源趋势变得困难。为此，我们分析了超过375篇论文，以回答三个互补的问题：(1) 自然语言处理系统正在针对哪些文化能力（CC）？(2) 文化数据资源是如何被创建的？以及(3) 采用了哪些方法来提升这些系统的CC？我们讨论了这三个问题中观察到的趋势，并确定了相关的研究空白。为了促进该领域的研究，我们以交互式网页界面的形式发布了我们分析的论文完整列表，其中包括一个允许研究人员添加其工作的功能；我们希望这能促进未来的研究，并成为文化NLP社区的重要资源。

articles.title: Replication Without Persistence in Hosted LLMs: Measurement Sensitivity in Action-Time Belief Evaluation
articles.abstract: Behavioural evaluations of hosted language models can vary because the evaluated service, the measurement instrument, or both differ across runs. We separate three validation questions: whether a prior finding recurs on fresh data under its historical configuration (replication), whether the endpoint changes when the evaluation-and-inference configuration is rebuilt under the same identifier (measurement sensitivity), and whether the finding persists across subsequently tested identifiers under one common instrument (persistence). We study these questions in Regent Chess, a sequential environment in which a hidden, mutable state is recorded exactly, allowing stated beliefs to be scored against ground truth at action time; positive endpoint values mean worse performance than a matched-uniform comparator. The previously reported Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite deficit recurs on fresh games under its historical configuration (+0.0530, 95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714]). In a back-to-back same-day H/R comparison under the same public identifier, the model-minus-uniform endpoint is 0.0429 lower under the rebuilt configuration (95% CI for the H-minus-R contrast [+0.0182,+0.0667]); all six configuration components vary jointly, so no component is isolated. Under rebuilt R, the prospectively frozen, interleaved same-window 4K comparison reverses sign between Gemini 3.1 and Gemini 3.7, identifiers that differ in release and product tier; additional descriptive and exploratory cells show the same directional pattern. Any additional serving-period contribution remains unresolved (-0.0166, [-0.0483,+0.0157]). Replication, measurement sensitivity, and persistence can therefore yield different conclusions within one evaluation, motivating explicit indexing of hosted-model behavioural claims by tested identifier, serving period, measurement instrument, and inference configuration.
articles.titleCn: 在托管式大型语言模型中无持久性复制：实时信念评估中的测量敏感性
articles.abstractCn: 对托管语言模型的行為评估可能因评估服务、测量工具或两者在运行中存在差异而有所不同。我们将验证问题分为三个：在历史配置下，先前发现是否在新鲜数据中重现（复制性）；在相同标识符下，当评估和推理配置重新构建时，端点是否发生变化（测量敏感性）；以及在一个共同工具下，发现是否在后续测试的标识符中持续存在（持久性）。我们在Regent Chess中研究这些问题，这是一个顺序环境，其中精确记录了一个隐藏的可变状态，允许在行动时间将陈述信念与真实情况评分；正端点值意味着与匹配均匀比较器相比表现更差。先前报告的Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite缺陷在其历史配置下在新鲜游戏中重现(+0.0530, 95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714])。在同一天进行的H/R背靠背比较中，在相同公共标识符下，模型减去均匀的端点在重新构建的配置下降低了0.0429(95% CI对于H减去R对比为 [+0.0182,+0.0667])；所有六个配置组件共同变化，因此没有组件被隔离。在重新构建的R下，前瞻性冻结的、交错的同窗口4K比较在Gemini 3.1和Gemini 3.7之间改变了符号，这两个标识符在发布和产品层级上有所不同；附加的描述性和探索性单元格显示了相同的方向模式。任何额外的服务周期贡献仍然未解决(-0.0166, [-0.0483,+0.0157])。因此，复制性、测量敏感性和持久性在一个评估中可能得出不同的结论，这促使我们对托管模型的行為声明进行明确的索引，包括测试标识符、服务周期、测量工具和推理配置。

articles.title: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts with Speculative Decoding via Expert Coactivation
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are increasingly deployed alongside Speculative Decoding (SD) to accelerate inference, but combining the two is challenging. SD improves the inference speed of dense models by verifying groups of tokens in parallel. However, the inference speedup for SD with MoEs depends heavily on the number of tokens being verified. Using more verification tokens results in more experts being transferred from DRAM to the Neural Processing Unit (NPU), which increases the memory transfer cost. This negatively impacts model runtime, as memory transfer is typically the bottleneck in inference. In this work, we investigate the impact of MoE router design during training on the speed of MoEs with SD. We find that routers with high degrees of expert coactivation result in much faster runtimes, mitigating the impact of using more verification tokens. Motivated by this observation, we assess the impact of various router design choices on expert coactivation and runtime using billion-parameter transformer models. We find that combining a global load-balancing loss, shared experts, a consistency loss, and an autoregressive expert selection mechanism during training results in significantly stronger expert coactivation. This increased coactivation translates into higher overall runtime throughput: our exploration yields a model that improves throughput by 21% over MoE baselines, while maintaining on-par accuracy with the baseline MoE.
articles.titleCn: 基于专家协同激活的推测解码高效专家混合模型
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）模型越来越多地与推测解码（SD）结合使用以加速推理，但两者结合存在挑战。SD通过并行验证标记组来提高密集模型的推理速度。然而，SD与MoE结合的推理加速效果很大程度上取决于验证标记的数量。使用更多验证标记会导致更多专家从DRAM迁移到神经处理单元（NPU），从而增加内存传输成本。由于内存传输通常是推理的瓶颈，这会负面影响模型运行时间。在这项工作中，我们研究了训练期间MoE路由器设计对SD加速MoE速度的影响。我们发现，具有高专家协同激活程度的路由器会导致运行时间显著加快，从而减轻了使用更多验证标记的影响。基于这一观察，我们使用具有数十亿参数的Transformer模型，评估了不同路由器设计选择对专家协同激活和运行时间的影响。我们发现，在训练期间结合全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择机制，可以显著增强专家协同激活。这种协同激活的增加转化为更高的整体运行时吞吐量：我们的探索产生了一个模型，其吞吐量比MoE基线提高了21%，同时保持了与基线MoE相当的性能。

articles.title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
articles.abstract: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.
articles.titleCn: 基于可穿戴数据使用语言模型提供个性化睡眠指导
articles.abstractCn: 基于可穿戴设备数据的睡眠监测已展现出在个人健康领域的潜力，然而基于大型语言模型（LLM）的总结和问答在个性化睡眠指导方面仍显不足。然而，训练专用模型通常需要高成本的专家标注。此外，隐私和可访问性问题促使为终端用户提供轻量级的本地部署方案。我们提出了一种两阶段框架来应对这些挑战。具体而言，在第一阶段，多智能体LLM管道从未标注的可穿戴记录中推理结构化睡眠指导，从而实现可扩展的数据集构建。第二阶段通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏到小型语言模型（SLM）中，并集成无训练的Best-of-$N$选择策略以增强推理能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于商业通用和医疗LLM以及开源模型。人工评估进一步支持了生成指导的质量以及使用SLM进行个性化睡眠指导的可行性。

articles.title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
articles.abstract: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of PHerc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

articles.titleCn: Apollo Restore：一个用于历史希腊语的底层大型语言模型，专为填补中间词恢复古希腊文本而优化
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Apollo Restore，一个拥有240亿参数的大型语言模型，用于恢复古希腊文本中因物理缺失而产生的空白。该模型基于Mistral Small进行微调，以填空任务为目标，能够重建缺失的文本片段，而无需知道其长度。据我们所知，这是首个用于历史希腊语的大型解码模型，也是首个用于任何古代地中海语言的模型。在与其他研究类似的方法评估下，对于长度不超过十个字符的短空白，Apollo Restore在文献-莎草纸、文学-莎草纸和石刻空白中，将正确恢复结果置于前二十候选中的80.6%/54.6%/61.0%，其表现优于已发表的最强模型1.6倍/2.6倍/1.4倍。然而，之前的评估协议通过偏向于极短的空白而夸大了分数；在长度均衡的指标下，Apollo Restore相对于最强已发表模型的优势增长至2.3倍/3.5倍/1.6倍，即使给出错误的长度提示也能优雅地表现。在一项盲法研究中，20位专家莎草纸学家、碑铭学家和语言学家强烈倾向于选择Apollo Restore，并在77%的情况下认为其表现至少与人工恢复相当。Apollo Restore还改进了对PHerc. 1667的解读——这是一卷在79年维苏威火山喷发时碳化的莎草纸卷，在Apollo Restore的训练数据编译后进行数字化展开和编辑。Apollo Restore是“解码古代”计划的产品，该计划由奥地利科学院领导，旨在为历史语言和手稿构建专用的大型语言模型。

articles.title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
articles.abstract: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.
articles.titleCn: Vox-Infinity：长上下文语音语言模型的极限测试
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文理解仍然是大型语言模型面临的一项基本挑战，因为过长的输入往往会导致模型遗忘显著信息。这个问题在语音领域更为突出，因为作为低压缩模态的音频，需要比文本多得多的嵌入才能保留语义内容和声学线索。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了\textbf{Vox-Infinity}，这是首个专门设计用于评估口语语言模型长上下文理解能力的基准。Vox-Infinity系统地沿两个维度扩展音频历史：轮次数量和轮次时长。它涵盖了具有不同交互结构和语义复杂性的各种代表性场景。关键的是，Vox-Infinity提供了明确的答案来源标注，并根据解决每个查询所需的历史上下文量对样本进行组织，从而实现精确且考虑长度的评估。对七个代表性语音语言模型的广泛评估揭示了一个清晰的整体近期效应：当答案支持证据靠近查询时，模型通常能获得更高的准确率，但在检索和使用对话历史中位于更靠后位置的证据时则表现不佳。案例和数据集可在https://vox-infinity.github.io获取。

articles.title: Cross-sector generalization of accident-process role classification in occupational accident narratives
articles.abstract: Occupational accident narratives contain valuable information about work situations, unfavourable conditions, accident events, and their consequences. Automatically structuring these narratives can facilitate large-scale accident analysis and support occupational risk prevention. However, the terminology and writing styles used to describe accidents vary considerably across sectors and organisations, raising questions about the ability of automated coding systems to generalize beyond their training domain. In this paper, we evaluate the cross-sector generalization of accident-process role classification in French occupational accident narratives. We construct an expert-annotated corpus in which factual units are classified into four roles: work situation (A0), explicitly reported unfavourable condition (A1), accident event or deviation (B), and reported consequence (C). The role classifiers are developed and selected exclusively on 42,244 factual units extracted from 6,040 construction-sector narratives and are then evaluated on unseen corpora from the metallurgy and chemistry--plastics sectors, as well as on an independently collected company corpus, without retraining or target-domain tuning of the role classifier. We compare frozen pretrained representations with task-specific fine-tuning and supervised representation-learning strategies. The results show that task-specific adaptation consistently improves cross-domain transfer over frozen representations. Across repeated training runs, the three leading task-adapted strategies achieved average balanced accuracies between 85.6% and 85.8% across the three target corpora. These findings support the development of transferable assisted-coding systems capable of consistently structuring heterogeneous occupational accident narratives for expert review and cross-sector prevention analysis.
articles.titleCn: 跨部门事故过程角色分类在职业事故叙述中的泛化
articles.abstractCn: 职业事故叙述包含了关于工作环境、不利条件、事故事件及其后果的宝贵信息。自动构建这些叙述的结构可以促进大规模事故分析并支持职业风险预防。然而，不同行业和组织描述事故所使用的术语和写作风格差异很大，这引发了关于自动编码系统是否能在其训练领域之外泛化的疑问。在本文中，我们评估了法国职业事故叙述中事故过程角色分类的跨行业泛化能力。我们构建了一个专家标注语料库，其中事实单元被分为四个角色：工作环境（A0）、明确报告的不利条件（A1）、事故事件或偏差（B）以及报告的后果（C）。角色分类器完全基于从6,040个建筑行业叙述中提取的42,244个事实单元进行开发和选择，然后在不重新训练或调整目标领域角色分类器的情况下，在冶金和化学-塑料行业的未见过语料库以及独立收集的企业语料库上进行评估。我们比较了冻结的预训练表示与特定任务微调和监督表示学习策略。结果表明，特定任务的适应始终比冻结表示的跨领域迁移效果更好。在重复训练运行中，前三个特定任务适应策略在三个目标语料库上的平均平衡精度在85.6%到85.8%之间。这些发现支持开发可迁移的辅助编码系统，该系统能够一致地构建异构职业事故叙述，用于专家审查和跨行业预防分析。

articles.title: Predictable Failure in Multi-Hop Retrieval: Score-Distributional Confidence Scoring and Abstention
articles.abstract: Multi-hop retrieval failures are not uniformly distributed across queries: they cluster in structurally predictable subpopulations. We prove two results formalizing this structure. First (CWAR Reducibility): confident-failure reduction is achievable if and only if retrieval features carry mutual information about success, a condition satisfied by LLM-judge pipelines but substantially weaker in dense-only settings, explaining the AUC-AC gap between regimes. Second (Feature Regime Complementarity): no single ANN score feature achieves best predictive performance across all failure regimes; the dominant feature differs between datasets (query length on MuSiQue, hop-1 concentration on HoVer), and a constructive witness pair shows each is necessary in one regime and non-contributory in the other. We instantiate these principles in RegimeAbstain, which computes a Retrieval Confidence Score (RCS), a logistic function of up to nine query-ANN structural features, all available without any additional LLM call, and uses it to implement a calibrated abstention policy. We define the Confident-Wrong-Answer Rate (CWAR) metric and evaluate across three multi-hop benchmarks (MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HoVer) and two retrieval architectures (LLM-judge and dense-only), covering five failure regimes with CWAR from 14.5% to 62.1%. RCS achieves best or co-best AUC-AC in all five conditions against eight confidence baselines. On MuSiQue (LLM-judge), RCS reduces CWAR from 39.5% to 20.6% at 50% coverage (47.8% relative reduction), with ECE=0.035. A model trained on MuSiQue transfers to 2WikiMultiHopQA with only -0.5pp AUC loss, confirming the domain-agnostic structure of regime features.

articles.titleCn: 多跳检索中的可预测失败：基于分数分布的置信度评分和弃权
articles.abstractCn: 多跳检索失败在查询中并非均匀分布：它们在结构上可预测的子群体中聚集。我们证明了两个结果，以形式化这种结构。首先（CWAR可约性）：当检索特征携带关于成功的互信息时，置信度失败约简是可实现的，这一条件在LLM-裁判管道中得到满足，但在仅使用密集设置中则显著较弱，解释了不同机制间的AUC-AC差距。其次（特征机制互补性）：没有任何单一的ANN分数特征能在所有失败机制中实现最佳预测性能；主导特征因数据集而异（MuSiQue上的查询长度，HoVer上的hop-1集中度），并且一个构造性证据对表明每个特征在一个机制中是必要的，而在另一个机制中则无贡献。我们在RegimeAbstain中实例化这些原则，该模型计算检索置信度分数（RCS），这是一个由最多九个查询-ANN结构特征组成的逻辑函数，所有特征均无需任何额外的LLM调用即可获得，并使用它来实现校准的放弃策略。我们定义了置信度错误答案率（CWAR）指标，并在三个多跳基准（MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HoVer）和两种检索架构（LLM-裁判和仅密集）上进行评估，覆盖五种失败机制，CWAR从14.5%到62.1%。RCS在所有五种条件下对八个置信度基线实现了最佳或并列最佳AUC-AC。在MuSiQue（LLM-裁判）上，RCS在50%覆盖率下将CWAR从39.5%降至20.6%（相对减少47.8%），ECE=0.035。一个在MuSiQue上训练的模型迁移到2WikiMultiHopQA时仅损失0.5pp的AUC，证实了机制特征的领域无关结构。

articles.title: An Interpretable Memory Decision Controller for LLM Agents Based on Three-Signal Complementarity: Decoupling Confidence and Consistency
articles.abstract: Memory systems for large language models have focused predominantly on efficient retrieval, whereas the decision of whether retrieved memories should be trusted has received comparatively little attention. When the memory store contains conflicting positions, standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) blindly injects memories and amplifies hallucinations: in models susceptible to memory injection, the RAG hallucination rate under conflicting memories is markedly higher than that of a memory-free baseline. Inspired by memory signaling mechanisms in the prefrontal cortex, we propose the Memory Decision Layer (MDL), a zero-parameter memory decision controller situated between the retrieval and generation stages. Its core is a three-signal complementary encoder that fuses relevance, reliability, and task risk through QR-based orthogonal subspace projection and a meta-working-memory signal into an interpretable decision representation that quantifies the trustworthiness of retrieved memories. Building on this encoder, MDL explicitly decouples confidence from consistency and introduces risk inversion and explicit abstention. Evaluations on mainstream large language models and multiple open-source datasets show that MDL reduces the hallucination rate under conflicting memories by about 56.04% in general scenarios and approaches zero hallucination in high-risk scenarios. The controller is fully white-box: it relies purely on geometric operations, requires no trained parameters, and adds only about 0.14 ms per decision -- roughly 50x faster than the embedding-retrieval step that precedes it and four to five orders of magnitude faster than an LLM self-evaluation call.

articles.titleCn: 基于三信号互补性为LLM智能体设计的可解释性记忆决策控制器：解耦置信度与一致性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的记忆系统主要集中于高效检索，而检索到的记忆是否值得信任这一决策问题则相对较少受到关注。当记忆库中存在冲突性信息时，标准的检索增强生成（RAG）会盲目注入记忆并放大幻觉：在易受记忆注入影响的模型中，存在冲突记忆时的RAG幻觉率显著高于无记忆基线模型。受前额叶皮层记忆信号机制启发，我们提出了记忆决策层（MDL），这是一种零参数的记忆决策控制器，位于检索和生成阶段之间。其核心是一个三信号互补编码器，通过基于QR的正交子空间投影和元工作记忆信号，融合相关性、可靠性和任务风险，生成一个可解释的决策表示，量化检索到的记忆的可信度。基于此编码器，MDL明确地将置信度与一致性分离，并引入风险反转和显式拒绝。在主流大型语言模型和多个开源数据集上的评估表明，MDL在一般场景下将冲突记忆下的幻觉率降低了约56.04%，在高风险场景下接近零幻觉。该控制器是完全白盒的：它完全依赖于几何运算，无需训练参数，每次决策仅增加约0.14毫秒——比其前置的嵌入检索步骤快约50倍，比LLM自我评估调用快四个到五个数量级。

articles.title: QuranicMMLU: A Cognitively-Aware Benchmark for Evaluating Generative AI Solutions on Quranic Linguistic Knowledge
articles.abstract: We introduce QuranicMMLU, a benchmark for evaluating generative AI on Quranic Arabic across multiple dimensions of linguistic complexity. Existing Quranic benchmarks center on general question answering and semantic retrieval, without probing specific linguistic competencies or stratifying by cognitive demand and verse difficulty. We construct a five-pillar Quranic taxonomy spanning Phonology, Morphology, Syntax, Semantics, and Pragmatics, with 31 leaves covering phenomena from tajwīd and root-and-pattern morphology to occasions of revelation and inter-surah coherence. For each leaf we generate questions stratified by Bloom's cognitive level and verse perplexity, then have LLM as a judge to independently answer and score every item and route the annotations to manual review. The resulting dataset comprises 980 human-reviewed questions, each issued in both open-ended and multiple-choice form. We benchmark 12 systems on these items and find that the Islamic-specialized model leads, yet every system scores higher on multiple-choice accuracy (average 84%) than open-ended answer quality (average 60%): the two rankings agree closely (Kendall's τ=0.73), but multiple-choice scoring hides failures that surface only once answer choices are removed. QuranicMMLU thus offers a rigorous, linguistically grounded framework for evaluating Arabic NLP in the Quranic domain.
articles.titleCn: 《古兰经知识认知基准：用于评估生成式人工智能解决方案在古兰经语言知识方面的基准》
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了QuranicMMLU，一个用于评估生成式AI在阿拉伯语古兰经上的多维度语言复杂度基准。现有的古兰经基准主要集中于一般问答和语义检索，而没有探究特定的语言能力或根据认知需求和经文难度进行分层。我们构建了一个包含语音学、形态学、句法学、语义学和语用学五个支柱的古兰经分类体系，涵盖31个叶节点，涉及 tajwīd（古兰经诵读规则）、根与模式形态学到启示场合和经文间连贯性等现象。对于每个叶节点，我们根据布鲁姆认知层次和经文困惑度生成分层问题，然后由大型语言模型作为独立裁判对每个项目进行回答和评分，并将标注结果提交人工审核。最终生成的数据集包含980个经人工审核的问题，每种问题形式均提供开放式和选择题两种版本。我们在这些问题上对12个系统进行基准测试，发现伊斯兰专业模型表现领先，但所有系统在选择题准确率（平均84%）上均高于开放式回答质量（平均60%）：两种排名高度一致（Kendall's τ=0.73），但选择题评分隐藏了只有在移除选项后才会暴露的失败。因此，QuranicMMLU提供了一个严谨、基于语言学的框架，用于评估古兰经领域的阿拉伯语自然语言处理。

articles.title: DiaVLo: Diagnosing Behaviours of Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on storing and transferring appropriate information across their sub-components. Verifying that the VLMs exhibit desired behaviours, while avoiding harmful ones, is central to their reliable deployment. Yet, methods that identify VLM behaviours remain scarce. We present DiaVLo, a diagnostic framework that leverages human curation and VLMs' generation capabilities to construct specifications of desired and observed VLM behaviours, surfacing potential misalignments. Beyond this, DiaVLo also provides causal estimates to identify the most influential concepts steering VLM behaviours. We evaluate DiaVLo on several open-source VLMs under both classification and generation conditions. Our experiments show that DiaVLo produces behaviour labels that correlate with model performance and provide context for measured performance. DiaVLo surfaced behaviours that are clearly aligned and misaligned, alongside patterns in how VLMs perceive, organise, and prioritise concepts.
articles.comment: 34 pages. To appear in EMNLP 2026 (findings)
articles.titleCn: DiaVLo：诊断视觉语言模型的行为
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）依赖于在其子组件之间存储和传递适当的信息。验证VLMs表现出期望行为，同时避免有害行为，是其可靠部署的核心。然而，识别VLM行为的方法仍然稀缺。我们提出了DiaVLo，一个利用人工管理和VLM生成能力来构建期望和观察到的VLM行为规范的诊断框架，以揭示潜在的偏差。除此之外，DiaVLo还提供因果估计，以识别引导VLM行为的最具影响力的概念。我们在分类和生成条件下对多个开源VLMs评估了DiaVLo。我们的实验表明，DiaVLo产生的行为标签与模型性能相关，并为测量性能提供了上下文。DiaVLo揭示了明显一致和不一致的行为，以及VLMs在感知、组织和优先级排序概念方面的模式。

articles.title: Abstention and Noise Filtering: Two Missing Primitives of Softmax Attention
articles.abstract: Gating the value pathway of attention reportedly improves language model pretraining, and prior studies disagree on why. We argue and provide experimental evidence that such gates supply two different things that softmax attention lacks: abstention and noise filtering. The first is abstention, which allows an attention head to output nothing, bypassing the requirement that attention weights must sum to one. The second is noise filtering, which allows the value pathway of an attention head to suppress interference from superposed features in the residual stream. In our experiments in matched models from 10M to 350M parameters, we supply abstention through a learned per-head sink logit in the softmax and noise filtering through a gate on each value. We report three empirical findings. First, the benefit of abstention, measured as the reduction in validation loss relative to a matched baseline, declines as models grow, whereas the benefit of noise filtering increases with scale. In particular, abstention accounts for nearly all of the gain from gating at 10M and filtering for most of it at 350M. Second, the best model at every scale is the one with both primitives built in. Third, injecting controlled interference into the values a head reads confirms that the gate removes such interference, and reveals that each of the two gate forms we study has a characteristic blind spot. Supplying both primitives adds negligible parameters and remains compatible with the key-value cache.

articles.titleCn: 弃权与噪声过滤：Softmax 注意力中的两个缺失原语
articles.abstractCn: 据称，通过控制注意力值路径可以改进语言模型的预训练，而先前研究对原因存在分歧。我们提出并通过实验证据证明，这些门控机制提供了softmax注意力所缺乏的两个不同要素：回避和噪声过滤。第一个要素是回避，它允许注意力头输出空值，绕过了注意力权重必须加和为1的要求。第二个要素是噪声过滤，它允许注意力头的值路径抑制残差流中叠加特征产生的干扰。在我们的实验中，我们使用从10M到350M参数的匹配模型，通过softmax中的每个头学习到的sink logit实现回避，通过每个值的门控实现噪声过滤。我们报告了三个经验性发现。首先，回避的收益（相对于匹配基线的验证损失减少量）随着模型规模的增长而下降，而噪声过滤的收益随规模增加而提升。具体而言，在10M参数时，回避几乎解释了所有门控带来的增益，而在350M参数时，噪声过滤解释了其中大部分增益。其次，每个规模下最佳模型都是内置了这两种机制（回避和噪声过滤）的模型。第三，向注意力头读取的值中注入受控干扰，证实了门控机制能够去除这种干扰，并揭示我们研究的两种门控形式各有一个特有的盲点。提供这两种机制增加了可忽略的参数数量，并且仍然与键值缓存兼容。

articles.title: RecreationWorld: Scalable and Verifiable Environments for Hybrid Computer-Use Agents
articles.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have advanced along two separate lines: graphical interaction and software development through code and the command line. Real digital work requires both, interleaved rather than stacked end to end. We study hybrid CUAs that autonomously decide when to explore an interface, implement software, and run and visually verify their artifacts. We introduce RecreationWorld, a five-platform framework built around recreation: given a running reference, an agent must discover its behavior and build a faithful implementation with no prescribed workflow. RecreationWorld provides reproducible environments on Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, Android, and Web, plus a unified harness with native GUI control and coding tools. The running reference serves as an oracle for hidden behavioral tests, providing execution-grounded rewards. We scale trajectory generation with high-quality open-source applications. Models trained on these trajectories improve across five out-of-distribution coding and hybrid computer-use benchmarks and more frequently verify their rendered outputs, providing evidence of transfer beyond recreation. For held-out evaluation, we introduce RecreationBench, comprising 250 diverse tasks across domains and platforms. Reference-grounded programmatic and visual assertions cover action-conditioned outcomes at multiple interaction depths; each is validated on the reference and by human reviewers before the suite is frozen for automatic scoring. GPT-6 Astra leads at 58.1% overall, but passes all programmatic tests on just 2.8% of tasks. Agents reproduce static interface structure more reliably than interactions and computed outputs, while generated applications remain smaller and more monolithic than their references. We release the benchmark, environments, and test suites.
articles.titleCn: 娱乐世界：混合计算机使用代理的可扩展和可验证环境
articles.abstractCn: 计算机使用代理（CUAs）沿着两条独立路线发展：图形交互和通过代码及命令行进行软件开发。真正的数字工作需要两者结合，而非简单堆叠。我们研究了一种混合型CUA，它能够自主决定何时探索界面、实现软件，并运行和可视化验证其成果。我们介绍了RecreationWorld，这是一个围绕娱乐构建的五平台框架：给定一个运行参考，代理必须发现其行为并构建一个忠实实现，无需预设工作流程。RecreationWorld在Ubuntu、macOS、Windows、Android和Web上提供可复现的环境，并附带一个统一接口，支持原生GUI控制和编码工具。运行参考作为隐藏行为测试的预言机，提供基于执行的奖励。我们用高质量的开源应用程序扩展了轨迹生成。在这些轨迹上训练的模型在五个分布外编码和混合计算机使用基准测试中表现提升，并更频繁地验证其渲染输出，证明了其超越娱乐的迁移能力。对于保留评估，我们引入了RecreationBench，包含250个跨领域和平台的多样化任务。基于参考的程序化和可视化断言覆盖多深度交互条件下的行为结果；每个断言在套件冻结用于自动评分前，均在参考上和人类评审员验证。GPT-6 Astra整体表现最佳，达到58.1%，但在仅2.8%的任务上通过所有程序化测试。代理比交互和计算输出更可靠地复现静态界面结构，而生成应用程序比参考更小且更模块化。我们发布了基准测试、环境和测试套件。

articles.title: Moral Entropy: Auditing Bias and Uncertainty in Moral Judgment
articles.abstract: Most work in computational ethics treats annotator disagreement on moral content as noise to be voted away, collapsed into majority vote or the more permissive any-annotator rule the moment a single annotator flags an item. We argue this uncertainty should instead be modeled and learned from. We introduce Moral Entropy, a Bayesian framework that keeps a full posterior over the true label and decomposes its entropy into aleatoric uncertainty (irreducible disagreement about the moral content) and epistemic uncertainty (from insufficient or noisy annotation) -- and lets any heuristic consensus rule be audited against a calibrated ground truth via entropy methods such as cross-entropy/KL, Brier score, and expected calibration error. Across three corpora and fifteen discourse domains, auditing the standard aggregation rules against this posterior reveals bias that no current pipeline reports: the any-annotator rule disagrees with the calibrated posterior on roughly 30% of items -- pooled, almost entirely false positives, though the errors invert at the foundation level (19.9%/38.9% mean FPR/FNR on MFTC) -- while the stricter majority and two-vote rules miss 63-83% of true positives.

articles.titleCn: 道德熵：审计道德判断中的偏见与不确定性
articles.abstractCn: 计算伦理领域的大多数研究将标注者对道德内容的分歧视为可通过投票消除的噪声，一旦有标注者标记某项内容，便会将其简化为多数投票规则或更宽松的任意标注者规则。我们认为，这种不确定性应当被建模和学习。我们引入了道德熵（Moral Entropy）这一贝叶斯框架，该框架保留了对真实标签的完整后验概率，将其熵分解为偶然不确定性（关于道德内容不可消除的分歧）和认知不确定性（源于标注不足或噪声），并允许通过交叉熵/KL散度、布里叶得分和预期校准误差等熵方法，对任何启发式共识规则进行校准后真实值的审计。在三个语料库和十五个话语领域中，通过审计标准聚合规则与该后验概率的差异，揭示了一种当前流程未报告的偏差：任意标注者规则与校准后验概率在约30%的项目上存在分歧——合并来看，几乎完全是假阳性，尽管错误在基础层面逆转（在MFTC上平均FPR/FNR分别为19.9%/38.9%）——而更严格的多数投票和两票规则则遗漏了63-83%的真实阳性结果。

articles.title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey
articles.abstract: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.
articles.comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中的情境因果性：一项调查
articles.abstractCn: 理解情境因果关系对于大型语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，因为它使它们能够准确识别特定情境中的因果关系，并支持更可靠的决策。尽管其重要性日益凸显，但利用LLMs对情境因果关系进行系统性探索仍显不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了关于该主题的全面综述。在本综述中，我们首先提出了情境因果关系的分类体系，包括语义因果关系、干预因果关系和反事实因果关系，并通过其核心因果关系问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务以及在因果关系分析中的实际应用来刻画每个类别。随后，我们分析了现有研究并讨论了其关键局限性。最后，我们考察了当前基准与现实需求之间的差距，并勾勒了未来研究的潜在方向。我们的目标是阐明LLMs在情境因果关系领域的研究格局，强调其重要性，并突出有前景的未来研究方向。

articles.title: NemotronLabs VoiceChat: An Open Full-duplex Speech-to-Speech Model with Tool Calling Capabilities
articles.abstract: We introduce NemotronLabs VoiceChat, an open full-duplex speech-to-speech model with native tool-calling capabilities. NemotronLabs VoiceChat combines a streaming speech encoder and decoder-only language model with parallel specialized output streams for agent text and structured function calls, an auxiliary RNN-T branch for incremental user transcription, and a streaming TTS decoder. This design enables the model to listen, transcribe, reason, invoke tools, and speak within a unified streaming architecture while preserving the temporal behavior required for natural conversation. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0, NemotronLabs VoiceChat achieves the lowest pause-handling takeover rates among evaluated open-weight systems, 100\% takeover following user interruptions, and a 4.33/5 post-interruption response-quality score. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5, it resumes its response after user backchannels in 93\% of cases. NemotronLabs VoiceChat obtains a 55.1 normalized average on VoiceBench and, on Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 (FDB 3.0), achieves 82.5\% tool-selection F1, while argument accuracy and end-to-end tool execution remain areas for improvement. These results demonstrate that full-duplex interaction, speech recognition and generation, general language capabilities, and external tool use can be integrated in a single open speech-to-speech model without sacrificing real-time conversational behavior.
articles.titleCn: NemotronLabs VoiceChat：一个具有工具调用功能的开放全双工语音转语音模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了NemotronLabs VoiceChat，这是一个具有原生工具调用能力的全双工语音到语音模型。NemotronLabs VoiceChat结合了流式语音编码器、仅解码器的语言模型，以及并行专用的输出流，用于代理文本和结构化函数调用；一个用于增量用户转录的辅助RNN-T分支，以及流式TTS解码器。这种设计使模型能够在统一的流式架构中实现倾听、转录、推理、调用工具和说话，同时保留自然对话所需的时序行为。在Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0上，NemotronLabs VoiceChat在评估的开权系统中最具最低暂停处理接管率，用户中断后100%接管，中断后响应质量得分为4.33/5。在Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5上，它在93%的情况下在用户回声后继续响应。NemotronLabs VoiceChat在VoiceBench上获得55.1的归一化平均分，在Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0（FDB 3.0）上，工具选择F1达到82.5%，而论点准确性和端到端工具执行仍是改进领域。这些结果表明，全双工交互、语音识别和生成、通用语言能力以及外部工具使用可以集成在单个开源语音到语音模型中，而不会牺牲实时对话行为。

articles.title: Detecting Pretraining Data in Large Language Models from a Free-Energy Perspective
articles.abstract: Detecting pretraining data in large language models is challenging because high likelihood can reflect either training exposure or strong generalization. In the joint space of prediction loss and predictive entropy, a likelihood-only detector uses a horizontal boundary and can mistake predictable non-members for members. Motivated by this, we introduce an inclined boundary that evaluates prediction loss relative to predictive entropy. Our analysis shows that entropy correction can preserve the expected membership signal while reducing its variance, thereby improving standardized member--non-member separation. We further extend the mean--variance analysis to the more general setting with a nonzero mean entropy gap. Interestingly, this entropy-adjusted score admits a Helmholtz free-energy interpretation, leading to Energy Transfer Detection (ETD), which views pretraining data detection from a macroscopic residual free-energy transfer perspective. Extensive experiments show that ETD achieves the best average detection performance, improving average AUROC by up to 3.5\% and TPR@5\%FPR by up to 5.1\%, while remaining robust across diverse settings.
articles.titleCn: 从自由能视角检测大型语言模型中的预训练数据
articles.abstractCn: 在大语言模型中检测预训练数据具有挑战性，因为高似然可能反映训练曝光或强大的泛化能力。在预测损失和预测熵的联合空间中，仅使用似然的检测器采用水平边界，可能会将可预测的非成员误判为成员。受此启发，我们引入了一个倾斜边界，该边界评估预测损失相对于预测熵。我们的分析表明，熵校正可以保留预期的成员信号，同时降低其方差，从而提高标准化成员-非成员分离效果。我们进一步将均值-方差分析扩展到具有非零均值熵差距的更一般设置中。有趣的是，这种熵调整分数具有亥姆霍兹自由能的解释，由此引出能量转移检测（ETD），它从宏观残余自由能转移的角度来审视预训练数据检测。大量实验表明，ETD实现了最佳平均检测性能，平均AUROC提高了3.5%，TPR@5%FPR提高了5.1%，同时在各种设置中保持稳健。

articles.title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
articles.abstract: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.
articles.titleCn: 试验图谱：临床试验设计与优化的多智能体研究组织
articles.abstractCn: 目前进入临床试验阶段的药物中，近90%最终会失败，尽管已经投入了数十亿美元的资金。因此，制药公司依赖于临床试验开发计划（CDP）以及技术和监管成功概率的评估来预见开发风险，但这些决策仍然非常耗时且主观，需要临床科学、统计学、监管事务和竞争情报领域的专家共同获取、综合和推理异构证据。在此，我们介绍了TrialAtlas，一个用于CDP的记忆增强多智能体研究组织，它通过协调专门用于文献综合、竞争性试验情报、监管先例分析和试验设计与开发风险综合推理的智能体来模拟这一协作过程。TrialAtlas进一步从历史临床试验和监管结果中学习，包括既往新药申请（NDA），以使其决策基于积累的开发经验。为了在真实的监管环境中评估这些能力，我们引入了TrialAtlasBench，它由291封FDA完整回复函构成，涵盖三个实际任务：检测试验设计缺陷、推荐可操作的改进设计以及预测技术和监管成功。TrialAtlas在缺陷检测方面达到了50.0%的F1分数，比最强的基线提高了6.1分，在技术和监管成功预测方面达到了85.3%的平衡准确率和84.7%的F1分数，在平衡准确率上比最佳基线提高了6.7分，在科恩kappa系数上提高了12.0分。在专家评估中，TrialAtlas生成的关注点中有86.4%被判定为有效，相比之下，OpenAI DeepResearch为83.1%，Gemini DeepResearch为59.3%。

articles.title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
articles.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used in social simulations for socially interactive agents and robots, offering more flexibility than rule-based systems. However, even though they mimic human behaviour very well, there is a persistent alienness to them. This work investigates whether personality-aware fine-tuning can reduce this gap by improving the consistency and controllability of personality-conditioned dialogue generation compared with instruction prompting alone. We fine-tune two small open-weight LLMs, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, using a corpus that combines personality-labelled social media posts and dialogues to create a personality-based dialogue engine for social simulation. The resulting models are evaluated across multiple social interaction scenarios using three independent LLM judges, which assess personality fidelity and provide evidence-based behavioral interpretations. We additionally quantify inter-rater agreement and lexical characteristics of the generated dialogue. Results indicate that fine-tuned models are not better at role-playing different personalities than their respective baseline models. However, low inter-rater agreement limits the confidence with which these results can be interpreted. Concerning the quality of generated texts, fine-tuned models are mostly comparable to the baselines, with fine-tuning improving the linguistic diversity of the Qwen models. While the results appear generally usable and the baseline models offer the best overall performance, future studies should place greater emphasis on the quality and domain alignment of training data for accurate personality role-playing.
articles.titleCn: 性格调优的大型语言模型是否使社交代理更出色？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在社会模拟中越来越多地用于社会交互代理和机器人，相较于基于规则的系统，它们提供了更高的灵活性。然而，尽管它们能很好地模仿人类行为，但它们始终存在一种持续的异质感。本研究探讨了通过改进基于性格的对话生成的连贯性和可控性，与单纯使用指令提示相比，性格感知微调是否能缩小这一差距。我们使用结合了带有性格标签的社交媒体帖子和对话的语料库，对两个小型开源权重LLMs（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Minstral-8B-Instruct）进行微调，以创建用于社会模拟的性格化对话引擎。生成的模型在多个社会交互场景中由三个独立的LLM评委进行评估，这些评委评估性格保真度并提供基于证据的行为解释。此外，我们还量化了对话生成中的评分者间协议和词汇特征。结果表明，微调模型在扮演不同性格方面并不优于各自的基线模型。然而，评分者间协议的低一致性限制了这些结果的可解释性。关于生成文本的质量，微调模型与基线模型大体相当，微调提升了Qwen模型的语言多样性。虽然结果总体上可用，且基线模型提供了最佳的整体性能，但未来的研究应更注重训练数据的质量和领域一致性，以实现准确的性格扮演。

articles.title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
articles.abstract: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.

articles.titleCn: 在转录文本中进行查询条件主题定位时重用潜在语音表征
articles.abstractCn: 长文本转录对下游NLP系统而言成本高昂，且常包含无关上下文。我们研究查询条件下的主题定位：预测转录文本中最佳回答主题标题查询的句子片段。为提升片段定位效果，我们复用语音识别编码器状态作为句子级表示，并将其与文本嵌入融合。这使得轻量级片段定位器能够利用语音信息，而无需运行独立的音频编码器。在两个公开数据集上的实验表明，相较于纯文本基线模型，我们的方法具有持续提升，尤其是在严格的边界匹配标准下。跨数据集实验进一步表明，结构化或半结构化语音的收益最为显著，而自发性语音的收益有限且效果不一。

articles.title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.
articles.titleCn: RheoSampling：解决随机动态树推测解码中的One-Hot困境
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过并行生成多个标记来加速大语言模型推理，基于树的方法通过分层结构进一步提高了效率。EAGLE-3等动态树方法在贪婪解码下表现良好，通过确定性top-K扩展和全局剪枝实现。然而，在随机解码（T>0）中，这种机制将生成分布压缩为one-hot概率，导致接受率大幅下降。这造成了一个困境：动态树方法为了保留上下文感知拓扑而牺牲随机采样，而静态树方法则通过上下文无关结构保留随机采样。问题在于，相同的概率分布被用于两个冲突的任务：构建树和验证标记。这种耦合使得随机性的直接注入变得困难，因为结果是一个随机过程。我们通过解耦这些角色来解决此问题：RheoSampling为从生成分布中采样的标记分配一个代理概率用于树扩展和剪枝，同时保留其用于验证的真实采样概率。具体而言，我们将采样的标记注入确定性top-K槽位中，并在构建和验证时以不同概率处理，使RheoSampling成为首个兼具上下文感知top-K构建和随机采样的动态树方法，同时保持无损性。我们通过等价类分析建立了无损性保证，将随机树空间压缩为可处理的类别。基于OT的验证策略和稀疏生成机制确保理论收益转化为实际效率。跨大语言模型和基准的实验展示了相较于最先进的动态树方法在接受率和加速方面的改进。该框架可能为分析随机树结构提供一个模板。

articles.title: CASCADE Against Jailbreaks: Combination Across Stages with Controlled Attack-Defense Evaluation
articles.abstract: Defenses against jailbreak attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) operate at different pipeline stages, such as input modification or output guard, but it remains unclear which defenses to deploy at each stage and how to combine them. Prior empirical studies, fragmented by inconsistent attack-success-rate definitions and experimental settings, have evaluated defenses largely in isolation. Here we present the first systematic study, to our knowledge, of defense combinations both within and across pipeline stages, under a consistent threat model of direct, black-box, single-turn attacks. Our decision framework standardizes evaluation through a principled attack-success-rate formulation with controlled query budgets, together with explicit fairness rules. Across 19 attacks and 15 defenses, we find that no single defense is universally best, but well-chosen combinations achieve substantial safety with minimal utility degradation, yielding practical recommendations for layered defense pipelines.

articles.titleCn: CASCADE防御越狱攻击：跨阶段组合与受控攻防评估
articles.abstractCn: 针对大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击的防御措施在不同的管道阶段进行操作，例如输入修改或输出保护，但仍然不清楚在各个阶段部署哪些防御措施以及如何组合它们。之前的实证研究由于攻击成功率定义不一致和实验设置碎片化，主要在孤立状态下评估防御措施。在此，我们首次（据我们所知）对跨管道阶段和内部管道阶段的防御措施组合进行了系统研究，在直接、黑盒、单轮攻击的一致威胁模型下进行。我们的决策框架通过采用受控查询预算的原则性攻击成功率公式以及明确的公平规则来标准化评估。在19种攻击和15种防御措施中，我们发现没有单一的防御措施是普遍最优的，但精心选择的组合在最小化效用下降的同时实现了显著的安全性，为分层防御管道提供了实际建议。

articles.title: Per-Aetiology Contrastive Severity Embeddings with Phonological Pseudo-Labelling for Multilingual Dysarthric Speech
articles.abstract: Most multilingual dysarthria-severity systems either train on a single aetiology-language pair or pool heterogeneous aetiologies into one label space. We test that pooling assumption with four matched HuBERT-base contrastive embedding models under a shared backbone, training recipe, corpus registry and held-out evaluation: one mixed-aetiology baseline and three aetiology-specific models for cerebral palsy (CP), Parkinson's disease (PD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Training combines clinically labelled speech with ordinal pseudo-labels from a training-free phonological profiling method [1], [2]. On speaker-disjoint, leakage-filtered held-out subsets, the per-aetiology models outperform the mixed baseline across all three target aetiologies: CP (macro F1 0.829 vs 0.676, +22.6 % relative), PD (0.715 vs 0.511, +40.0 %) and ALS (0.788 vs 0.596, +32.3 %). On CP, adding 144 SAP and 44 CDSD pseudo-labelled speakers lifts macro F1 from 0.786 to 0.829 over a clinical-only CP model (+4.3 percentage points). Training data span three to seven languages per aetiology. We position this as a controlled comparison of label-space design choices and discuss pseudo-label calibration, split hygiene, and confidence-thresholded deployment as important limitations for future work.

articles.titleCn: 基于病因的对比严重程度嵌入与语音伪标签用于多语言构音障碍语音
articles.abstractCn: 大多数多语言失语症严重程度评估系统要么基于单一病因-语言对进行训练，要么将异质病因合并到一个标签空间中。我们通过四个在共享主干、训练方案、语料库注册和保留评估集下匹配的HuBERT-base对比嵌入模型来验证合并假设：一个混合病因基线模型和三个特定病因模型，分别针对脑瘫（CP）、帕金森病（PD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）。训练结合了临床标记语音和来自无训练语音学分析方法的序数伪标签[1][2]。在说话人独立、泄漏过滤的保留子集上，针对每个病因的模型在三个目标病因中均优于混合基线模型：CP（宏观F1 0.829 vs 0.676，相对提升22.6%）、PD（0.715 vs 0.511，相对提升40.0%）和ALS（0.788 vs 0.596，相对提升32.3%）。在CP上，增加144名SAP和44名CDSD伪标记说话人将仅临床标记的CP模型的宏观F1从0.786提升至0.829（提升4.3个百分点）。每个病因的训练数据涵盖三到七种语言。我们将此定位为标签空间设计选择的受控比较，并讨论伪标签校准、分割卫生和置信度阈值部署作为未来工作的重要局限性。

articles.title: World Modeling in Transformers
articles.abstract: Behavioral failures can make a transformer appear to lack a world model even when it has learned faithful representations of its environment. We demonstrate this in TaxiGPT, a transformer trained on random walks through Manhattan whose failures have been interpreted as evidence of an incoherent internal map. Through mechanistic analysis and causal interventions, we show that the model represents intersections and streets, tracks its position, and uses a goal compass to navigate. We trace its failures to interference between superposed intersection features, which disrupts localization within the internal map. Affordance packing, which groups representations of intersections with the same legal moves, helps limit the consequences of these errors. Finally, we propose mechanistic indicators that we use to compare models and show that world-modeling capacities emerge at different stages of training. Our findings motivate a shift from asking whether a model has a world model to mechanistically studying its world modeling: the interacting capacities through which it represents its environment and uses those representations to guide behavior.
articles.titleCn: Transformer中的世界建模
articles.abstractCn: 行为性失败可能使一个Transformer即使已经学习到其环境的忠实表征，也表现得似乎缺乏世界模型。我们在TaxiGPT中展示了这一点，TaxiGPT是一个在曼哈顿随机游走中训练的Transformer，其失败被解释为内部地图不连贯的证据。通过机制分析和因果干预，我们证明该模型表征了交叉路口和街道，追踪其位置，并使用目标指南针进行导航。我们将其失败归因于叠加交叉路口特征的干扰，这种干扰破坏了内部地图中的定位。可供性打包，即将具有相同合法移动的交叉路口表征进行分组，有助于限制这些错误的影响。最后，我们提出了机制指标，用于比较模型，并表明世界建模能力在训练的不同阶段出现。我们的研究促使人们从询问模型是否具有世界模型，转向对其世界建模进行机制性研究：即模型通过何种交互能力表征其环境，并利用这些表征来指导行为。

articles.title: CIBuzzBench: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Understanding of Chinese Internet Buzzwords
articles.abstract: Chinese social media has generated a vast and continually evolving lexicon of internet buzzwords whose meanings are often non-literal and deeply rooted in local cultural and pragmatic contexts. Existing research has primarily focused on interpreting these buzzwords within Chinese, leaving largely unexplored whether LLMs can transfer such culturally grounded knowledge across languages and accurately convey the intended meanings in English. This cross-lingual capability is also critical for safety, as harmful expressions may obscure their offensive content through culture-specific homophony, euphemism, irony, or coded language. In this paper, we investigate the ability of advanced LLMs to understand Chinese internet buzzwords across languages. To this end, we introduce CIBuzzBench, the first benchmark for cross-lingual Chinese-to-English understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords. CIBuzzBench comprises 3,001 Chinese internet buzzwords annotated with English meaning explanations, English equivalents, category labels, and harmfulness labels. Based on these annotations, we design three evaluation tasks: Meaning Explanation, Cross-lingual Equivalent Matching, and Culturally Grounded Harmfulness Detection. We evaluate representative state-of-the-art proprietary and Chinese LLMs under both English- and Chinese-prompting settings. Our results show that LLMs continue to struggle with the cross-lingual understanding of Chinese internet buzzwords, particularly in fine-grained non-literal interpretation, robust equivalent matching under option perturbations, and calibrated harmfulness detection. These findings highlight the persistent challenges posed by culturally grounded language phenomena for multilingual LLMs and safety-oriented evaluation. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/CIBuzzBench.
articles.titleCn: CIBuzzBench：一个用于跨语言理解中文网络热词的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 中国社交媒体产生了一个庞大且不断演变的网络流行语词汇，这些词汇的含义往往非字面化，并深深植根于当地文化和语境之中。现有研究主要集中在中国内对这些流行语进行解读，而较少探索大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够跨语言传递这种文化基础知识，并准确传达其意图含义。这种跨语言能力对于安全也至关重要，因为有害表达可能通过特定文化的谐音、委婉语、反语或暗语来掩盖其攻击性内容。在本文中，我们研究了先进LLMs理解跨语言中文网络流行语的能力。为此，我们引入了CIBuzzBench，这是首个用于跨语言中文到英文理解中文网络流行语的基准。CIBuzzBench包含3001个中文网络流行语，标注了英文含义解释、英文对应词、类别标签和有害性标签。基于这些标注，我们设计了三个评估任务：含义解释、跨语言对应匹配和文化基础的有害性检测。我们在英文提示和中文提示两种设置下评估了代表性的先进专有和中文LLMs。我们的结果表明，LLMs在跨语言理解中文网络流行语方面仍然面临挑战，尤其是在细粒度的非字面化解释、选项扰动下的稳健对应匹配以及校准的有害性检测方面。这些发现突出了文化基础语言现象对多语言LLMs和安全导向评估的持续挑战。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/SuperYFan/CIBuzzBench获取。

articles.title: Listen Before You Speak: Response Planning from Listener Facial Reactions for Conversational Speech Generation
articles.abstract: Conversational speech depends on dialogue context and the listener's immediately preceding behavior. We propose ReACT-TTS, a two-stage framework that uses a one-second pre-response listener facial sequence to plan the next utterance's emotion and prosody before speech realization. On a strict dyadic MELD protocol, Temporal conditioning yields higher mean macro-F1 and VAD concordance than Text-only across ten seeds, while accuracy remains essentially unchanged. Ablations show that temporal modeling performs best among the visual variants and that an explicit early-to-late difference is unnecessary; correct listener reactions also outperform cyclic mismatches on average. In a contextual-appropriateness study with 20 speech researchers, 76% of judgments prefer Temporal, 9% Text-only, and 15% report no preference. We further connect the predicted response style to a Grad-TTS backbone for end-to-end speech realization. Overall, the results support pre-response listener dynamics as complementary cues for conversational response planning. The source code is available at https://github.com/CYJ1/ReACT-TTS_public.

articles.titleCn: 在开口之前先倾听：基于听众面部反应的对话式语音生成中的响应规划
articles.abstractCn: 对话式语音依赖于对话语境和听众的即时先前行为。我们提出了ReACT-TTS，一个两阶段框架，该框架使用一秒钟的预响应听众面部序列，在语音实现之前规划下一句话的情绪和韵律。在一个严格的二元MELD协议上，时间条件比纯文本产生更高的平均宏观F1和VAD一致性，而准确率基本保持不变。消融实验表明，时间建模在视觉变体中表现最佳，且早期到晚期之间的显式差异并非必要；正确的听众反应平均优于循环不匹配。在一项涉及20位语音研究者的语境适宜性研究中，76%的判断倾向于时间条件，9%倾向于纯文本，15%表示没有偏好。我们进一步将预测的响应风格与Grad-TTS主干连接起来，以实现端到端的语音生成。总体而言，结果支持预响应听众动态作为对话式响应规划的补充线索。源代码可在https://github.com/CYJ1/ReACT-TTS_public获取。

articles.title: The Spoken Wikipedia Presentation Corpus
articles.abstract: We present the Spoken Wikipedia Presentation Corpus, an extension of the Spoken Wikipedia Corpora featuring LLM-generated slide decks for multimodal ASR. Slides are created from LLM-segmented sections using a hybrid pipeline that combines LLM-based content planning with rule-based design decisions. For each section, an LLM generates a slide title, bullet points, a takeaway message, and a visual description that is used to create an illustration. Rule-based matching then selects layouts, themes, and styles to produce the final slides. A vision LLM extracts slide text as Markdown. We evaluate multiple ASR and spoken language models (SLMs). The best model achieves an average micro-WER of 10.23% and an average micro-CER of 6.48% on audio-only inputs. English yields the lowest error rates, followed by German and Dutch, while performance declines across lower-resource languages. Although audio-only baselines are strong, multimodal zero-shot prompting of omni models remains challenging. The aligned slide, text, and audio data show a strong potential to improve recognition through cross-modal context.
